# Hero full-body reference (human-provided, `full_body.png`, DVC-tracked; do not edit)

- Side view (profile, facing left), full body, plain dark grey background.
- Mesh/chainmail hood over a pale face; armoured torso of weathered dark metal with rust-orange wear; green box backpack on two straps, with a hose running up to the hood.
- Armoured thigh plates, wide and boxy, reaching down to the knee.
- Below the knee: thin mechanical shins bent backwards (digitigrade), no calf mass.
- Feet are curved blades, three long tines each, curving forward and touching the ground at their tips.
